043package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
044
045import java.lang.System.Logger;
046import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
047import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
048
049import javax.swing.text.DateFormatter;
050import javax.swing.text.DefaultFormatterFactory;
051
052import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
053
054import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
055
056/**
057 * Used to link a SsTimeField to a time column in a database.
058 */
059@SuppressWarnings("serial")
060public class SsTimeField extends DateTimeField {
061  /** Logger for component */
062  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
063
064  /**
065   * Create an SSTimeField using the default format.
066   */
067  public SsTimeField() {
068    this(SsFormat.TIME);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   *  Creates an SSTimeField with the specified format.
073   *  @param format - an enum format to be used while the date field is in edit mode
074   */
075  public SsTimeField(SsFormat format) {
076    this(createFormatterFactory(format));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Creates an object of SSTimeField with the specified formatter factory
081   * @param factory - formatter factory to be used
082   */
083  public SsTimeField(AbstractFormatterFactory factory) {
084    super(factory);
085    setValue(new java.util.Date());
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Create TIME formatter factory with specified format pattern.
090   * @param _format - Format to use for time while in editing mode.
091   * @return a DefaultFormatterFactory for the specified time format
092   */
093  public static DefaultFormatterFactory createFormatterFactory(SsFormat _format) {
094    SsFormat format = _format;
095    if (_format.getType() != SsFormat.TIME) {
096      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> sf("%s is not a TIME, using default", _format.toString()));
097      format = SsFormat.TIME;
098    }
099    format = SsFormat.getActualFormat(format);
100    String formatMask;
101    String editPattern;
102    switch (format) {
103      case TIME_HHMMSS -> {
104        formatMask = "##:##:##";
105        editPattern = "HHmmss";
106      }
107      default -> {
108        logger.log(Level.ERROR, "Unknown date format type of " + format);
109        return null;
110      }
111    }
112    return new MaskFormatterFactory.Builder<>(formatMask)
113        .ssFormat(format)
114        .stringValidator(DateTimeField::stringValidator)
115        .converter(new DateFormatter(new SimpleDateFormat(editPattern)))
116        .placeholderCharacter('_')
117        .build();
118  }
119}
